task.title: Task progress indicator in sidebar
task.description: Show a small progress indicator (e.g., 3/7) next to each task in the sidebar kanban TreeView, based on how many plan.xml tasks are marked complete. Provides at-a-glance implementation progress without opening the file.
task.problem: When viewing the sidebar kanban, there is no way to see how far along a task's implementation is without opening the plan.xml file. Users have to click into each task to check progress, which breaks their flow and slows down board scanning.
task.value: At-a-glance progress visibility in the sidebar reduces context-switching. Users can quickly identify which tasks are nearly done, which just started, and where to focus — all without leaving the kanban view.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a task has a plan.xml with implementation tasks When the task is displayed in the sidebar kanban TreeView Then a progress indicator like "3/7" is shown in the TreeView item description And the numerator reflects the count of completed tasks in plan.xml And the denominator reflects the total count of tasks in plan.xml
Given a task does not have a plan.xml When the task is displayed in the sidebar kanban TreeView Then no progress indicator is shown
Given a plan.xml file is modified (tasks completed or added) When the file watcher detects the change Then the progress indicator updates to reflect the new counts
